teams.detail: Four-star cornerback Censere Gaylord committed to Washington on July 11, choosing the Huskies over Georgia and Georgia Tech in one of the cycle's most competitive DB recruitments. He joins three-star in-state corner Maurice Williams as Jedd Fisch's staff builds its next perimeter tandem; no game until the Apple Cup opener vs. Washington State, Sunday, Sept. 6 (1 p.m. PT, NBC).

Danny Sprinkle is rebuilding largely through the transfer portal after Zoom Diallo's departure, anchored by Croatian forward Boris Tisma's commitment. Center Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Charlotte Hornets in the 2026 NBA Draft, the program's highest pick in years.

Rookies reported to training camp Friday; veterans report July 24 with the first of 10 public practices (already sold out) on July 25 in Renton. Seattle will also headline HBO's Hard Knocks this preseason, its first appearance on the show; new OC Brian Fleury takes over after Klint Kubiak left to become the Raiders' head coach.

Detroit closed a 1-4 Las Vegas Summer League with No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie scoring 27 in the finale. The bigger offseason story is a six-team trade sending Caris LeVert and two second-rounders to Milwaukee for Taurean Prince and Gary Harris, part of a broader shakeup that also included the John Collins signing and Isaiah Stewart's move to Memphis.

Seattle improved to 49-50 (2nd, AL West, holding a wild-card spot) after Julio Rodriguez's walk-off sacrifice fly and a Cole Young three-run homer beat the Giants 4-3 in 10 innings Saturday. The series finale is underway today at T-Mobile Park (1:10 p.m. PT first pitch).

headlines.headline: Michigan's Mike Boynton Jr. takes over permanently as Wolverines defend their title without Dusty May
headlines.detail: Michigan promoted interim coach Mike Boynton Jr. to the permanent job after Dusty May left the reigning national champions for the Dallas Mavericks' head-coaching vacancy in late June. Boynton's recruiting ties and system familiarity were seen as the best chance to keep the roster intact through the transition.

headlines.headline: Grizzlies' Cameron Boozer and Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg meet tonight for the Summer League title
headlines.detail: No. 3 pick Cameron Boozer and Memphis face No. 11 pick Yaxel Lendeborg and Golden State in Sunday's 9 p.m. ET championship on ESPN after the Warriors eliminated a Lakers team that had won six straight, and the Grizzlies got 28 points from Cedric Coward to beat Houston in their semifinal.

headlines.headline: Training camps open league-wide as Alvin Kamara re-ups with the Saints and contract clocks run out on holdouts
headlines.detail: Kamara agreed to a restructured deal to stay in New Orleans as veterans face a July 24 report deadline, with unresolved talks - including the Ravens' Zay Flowers and the Cowboys' George Pickens, who will play 2026 on his franchise tag - racing the calendar. The suspension of Cardinals scouting executive Ryan Gold for leaking draft picks and gambling remains the offseason's biggest disciplinary story.

headlines.headline: SEC Kickoff Fan Fest hits Tampa Sunday night as four-day Media Days opens Monday with Lane Kiffin's LSU debut
headlines.detail: The SEC's broadcast coverage begins Sunday night with a Fan Fest special ahead of Monday's official start to Media Days, where Lane Kiffin makes his first appearance as LSU's coach after leaving Ole Miss mid-Playoff-run. Five first-year head coaches headline a conference entering its fourth straight season without a national title.
